speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: Do you know what Save the Children is?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: I have heard about it. What do you know about it?

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: Save the Children is an organization that helps children in developing countries, by promoting children's rights and providing relief. I think they help pay for their education and other necessities.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Do you have any experince dealing with them at all?

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: I personally haven't ever dealt with them, I have just seen a lot of commercials and heard about the organization for many years.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: I have heard that they work hard to give kids a better life.

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: Yes, I have heard that about them too. I have thought about donating before, but never got around to it. Would you be willing to donate some, or all, of your payment from this task to Save the Children?

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes, I think I would be will to donate to the cause.

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: I think I would be willing to as well. It appears that there is an option to donate some of your earnings, and the research team will collect all donations and send it to Save the Children :)

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Oh that is really a great idea. I think I would be able to donate some of my earnings. Would $1 help at all?

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: That sounds great! I'm guessing you would input your donation amount at the end of the task.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: I would be glad to. How much are you giving?

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: I'm going to give $1 as well :)

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Well that is really great. It sounds like a great charity. I think they might even help in Hawaii with the recent floods, don't you think? I bet the kids there are in need.

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: Yeah, I think they are doing some really important work! I'm not sure exactly how the donations they get are distributed and if it only goes to developing countries, or also to disaster relief.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes, I'm not sure either, but it just kills me to know there are ids suffering. How do you feel?

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: I feel the same. It makes me so sad to know that some children are having a hard time even finding clean water to drink. I think it's important for those of us in a first world country to help, but it's also so easy to overlook these things. I know I have.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes, sometimes I feel a little guilty that I have it so easy. I can not imagine food or clothing being a luxury. Can you?

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: I can't imagine that either. Those are things I've just always had, so sometimes I feel guilty that I haven't tried to do more to help others.

speaker: A25L985XCNESXE
text: Yes, it really does cause feelings of guilt!

speaker: A1M8NE16ROONAA
text: I completely agree! It's not that we don't all have our own struggles, but it's just on a completely different level.
